firstrun_body_post: your role needs. After you submit, your supervisor reviews it — once they validate, your readiness score and development plan appear here.
stat_coverage_title: Readiness is measured over the requirements assessed so far; the rest are not yet counted.
gaps_none_defined: No role skill requirements found for your role yet.
nb_empty: You have not been placed on the 9-box grid yet. Your manager calibrates this; once approved it appears here.
qa_sa_body: Rate yourself against your role's skill requirements during the current assessment cycle.
qa_status_body: Track where your assessment is in the review process.
qa_reviews_body: View your supervisor's feedback and raise a dispute if needed.
qa_idp_body: Track your active IDP — objectives, actions, and progress.
qa_coaching_body: Schedule and review your coaching / mentoring sessions.
sa_subtitle: Rate your skills for your role:
sa_instructions_body: Rate your current skill level for each required skill. You can save as draft and submit when ready.
sa_intro_1: Think about what you really do at work today.
sa_intro_2: Tap ⓘ to see what the skill and each level mean.
sa_intro_3: Torn between two levels? Pick the one you reach on your own, most of the time.
sa_intro_4: There is no wrong answer: your manager will discuss it with you.
sa_intro_5: Everything saves automatically; you can come back later.
sa_help_no_desc: This skill has no description yet. Use its name and the levels below. If unsure, write your question in the notes: your manager will answer it.
sa_nudge_evidence: A recent example where you did it, or taught someone?
sa_nudge_training: Would you like training on this?
scale_1_title: Aware of the skill; needs full supervision
scale_4_title: Mastery — can perform and coach others
sa_req_note_mid: is the minimum your role needs. Skills marked
sa_req_note_post: must be met regardless of your overall readiness.
sa_confirm_msg: Submit your self-assessment? Once submitted you cannot edit it until your supervisor reviews it.
sa_toast_submitted: Self-assessment submitted! Your supervisor will review it.
err_already_submitted: This assessment looks like it was already submitted. Refresh the page to see its current status.
err_invalid_data: Some of the data sent was not valid. Reload the page and try again.
err_invalid_assessments: Invalid self-assessment data. Reload the page and try again.
err_rate_at_least_one: Rate at least one skill before submitting.
err_nothing_to_save: Nothing to save — rate at least one skill first.
err_validation: Some of the information is invalid. Check your entries and try again.
err_unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
err_unknown: Something went wrong — please try again.
status_subtitle: Track each self-assessment through review and respond to comments.
sr_sysnote_auto_finalized: Closed automatically: no HR decision within the deadline.
sr_sysnote_hr_arbitration_required: HR arbitration required: the review carries no reviewer rating.
sr_sysnote_promotion_withheld_superseded: Promotion withheld: this round was replaced by a more recent campaign; the official level stays the current round's.
sr_prompt_reason: Please explain why you are disputing this review:
sr_confirm_dispute: Dispute this review? Your reviewer will be notified.
sr_toast_disputed: Review disputed — your reviewer will look into it.
mc_subtitle: Update your progress and complete assigned actions.
okr_intro: Your objectives with measurable key results, and your 1-on-1 sessions with your manager.
okr_goals_hint: Your manager sets objectives with you — update your key-result progress here as you advance.
okr_checkins_hint: Upcoming and past check-ins with your manager. Add talking points you want to raise; tick actions as you complete them.
okr_no_goals: No objectives yet — your manager can set them with you.
okr_no_checkins: No 1-on-1 sessions yet — your manager can schedule one.
sa_deadline_over: the campaign has closed — submit as soon as possible
sa_kbd_hint: Keyboard: 0–4 to rate · J/K or ↑↓ to move
mc_err_generic: Something went wrong — please try again.
sa_no_skills_title: Your role's skills aren't set up yet
sa_no_skills_body: There are no competencies defined for your role at the moment. Your administrator is still configuring it — please check back soon, or contact your manager if this seems wrong.
dash_purpose: Rate your skills, track your gaps and move your development plan forward
start_here_body: Begin with your self-assessment: it is what feeds your readiness score, your skill gaps and your development plan.
loop_nav_my_reviews_title: See your supervisor's decision and the reason behind it
loop_flow_intro: Every skill you send moves from hand to hand until a decision is made. Here you can see who is holding it right now and, once a decision is made, the level retained and the reason for it.
loop_flow_empty: Nothing pending: none of your skills is currently with a reviewer. Decisions already made are listed below.
loop_flow_error: Your assessments in progress cannot be shown right now.
loop_flow_nojs: The detailed view requires JavaScript. Decisions already made remain visible in the table below.
loop_acr_note: Does a submitted or validated assessment need to be corrected?
loop_with_unassigned: waiting to be assigned to a reviewer
loop_no_decision_yet: No decision has been made on this skill yet.
loop_campaign_none: No assessment campaign is open for you at the moment.
loop_campaign_all_required: Every skill your department defined for your role is to be assessed — none are removed from the list.
dev_subtitle: The plans that concern you: what is planned, what is expected of you, and where each step stands.
dev_load_error: Some information could not be loaded. Try again in a moment — nothing is lost.
dev_empty_body: That is normal: a development, coaching or improvement plan opens through the conversations you have with your manager.
dev_empty_hint: As soon as a plan concerns you, it appears here with what is expected of you and the agreed dates.
dev_expected_intro: Here, at a glance, are the open items you are expected to act on.
dev_pip_intro: An improvement plan states what is expected, how success will be measured, the review points planned and the support made available to you.
dev_pip_readonly: This plan is maintained by your manager. To adjust it or raise a difficulty, speak with them directly.
dev_pip_closed_note: Closed plans stay listed for the record.
dev_idp_intro: Your development plan lists the objectives agreed with your manager and the concrete actions to reach them.
dev_idp_none: No individual development plan concerns you.
dev_idp_no_objectives: No objective has been recorded on this plan yet.
dev_idp_no_actions: No action has been recorded on this plan yet.
dev_idp_due_tbd: to be agreed with your manager
dev_idp_sign_help: Signing confirms that you have read the plan and commit to its objectives. The plan becomes active once both signatures are recorded.
dev_idp_readonly: The content of this plan is maintained by your manager. To propose an adjustment, speak with them.
dev_coaching_none: No coaching plan concerns you right now.
cert_nav_title: My certifications and their revalidation dates
cert_subtitle: Your certifications and verifications of competency (VOC): which ones you hold, until when, and what your role requires.
cert_load_error: Your certifications could not be loaded. Try again in a moment; if it persists, tell your manager.
cert_action_missing: Certification(s) your role requires and that are not recorded yet
cert_action_contact: To schedule the revalidation (VOC), speak to
cert_action_contact_unknown: To schedule the revalidation (VOC), speak to your line manager.
cert_action_learning: A refresher course has been assigned to you.
cert_alert_note: You are alerted 90, 60 and 30 days before the expiry date, then on the day it is passed. This page always shows today's real state.
cert_required_intro: The skills of your role that carry a certification or VOC, with whatever is recorded in your name.
cert_required_none: No certification is required for your role in the framework.
cert_not_held_hint: No certification is recorded in your name for this requirement.
cert_other_intro: Certifications recorded in your name for skills that are not among the certifications your current role requires.
cert_none_held_body: No certification is recorded in your name yet. The requirements above show what your role asks for.
cert_readonly: This page is read-only: a certification or VOC is recorded by your manager or by compliance, together with the supporting evidence.
cert_empty_title: Nothing to track here for now
cert_empty_body: No certification is recorded in your name, and your role requires none in the framework.
cert_empty_hint: That is perfectly normal — nothing is expected of you here. If a certification is issued to you, it will appear on this page with its expiry date.
sa_locked_title: This competency has been submitted or validated and can no longer be edited here. Ask your manager to reopen it.
sr_gap_pending_title: Your supervisor has not decided yet: no rating and no gap have been set.
sa_notes_locked_title: This assessment has been submitted: its note can no longer be edited. Contact your manager to add anything further.
sa_notes_locked_ph: Note is read-only — this assessment has already been submitted.
sa_toast_partial_skipped: {{n}} row(s) were NOT saved: already submitted or approved. Everything else was saved.
qa_profile_body: Check your contact details: the email address stored here receives your password-reset link.
qa_profile_body_no_email: No email address is stored on your account: without one you cannot reset your own password. Add it now.
sr_err_not_own_review: You can only dispute your own reviews.
sr_err_not_disputable: This review cannot be disputed: it has not been decided yet, or it is already under dispute.
sr_err_reason_required: A written reason is required to dispute this review.
sr_err_dispute_failed: Your dispute could not be recorded. Please try again.
sr_err_round_superseded: This review is about a round replaced by a more recent campaign: dispute the review of the current round instead.
loop_campaign_locked_note: This campaign is locked: its counters will no longer move. Any rating saved or submitted now is filed outside the campaign — your supervisor still sees and reviews it, but it is not counted here.
sa_no_campaign_body: Ratings you save or submit now will be filed outside any campaign: your supervisor still sees and reviews them, but they do not feed any campaign counter.
firstrun_measured_title: Your supervisor has already assessed your skills
firstrun_measured_pre: Your role readiness is measured at
firstrun_measured_mid: from those assessments. Your own self-assessment on the
firstrun_measured_post: is still to do — it feeds the review and your development plan.
sa_locked_body: You can no longer save an assessment for this campaign. Contact your manager if you still need to complete it.
err_cycle_locked: This campaign is locked: your changes were not saved.
err_cycle_changed: The campaign changed since this page was opened. Reload it before saving.
dev_placement_note: This placement was deliberately disclosed to you by your reporting line. It stays confidential outside it.
dev_pip_summary_neutral: Improvement plan opened following a performance review.
emp_email_change_denied: Changing another person’s e-mail address requires the “Reset passwords” capability: the address was not changed.
emp_supervisor_out_of_scope: That supervisor is outside your scope: the reporting line was not changed.
emp_manager_out_of_scope: That manager is outside your scope: the reporting line was not changed.
line_manager_title: No active supervisor: the reporting line runs through the manager.
line_admin_title: No active supervisor: this person reports to an administration account named as their manager.
line_inactive_title: The recorded supervisor is no longer active and no active manager takes over.
